summary: Frontend-only Playwright validation of the 2 reported carousel bugs plus regressions (9/9 scenarios PASS). Accueil (/accueil/fbf_accueil.php): #carousel-menu now contains exactly 8 (0

issues: Cosmetic: .carousel-container height is 500px while .carousel-slide img height is 400px, leaving ~100px of empty background inside the rounded container below the image (visible gap before the footer, more noticeable on mobile 390x800). Suggest height:400px or height:auto.

Cosmetic: several source images are very low resolution (presentation.jpg, animaux_gallery.jpg, Jules.jpg, vaches_gallery_3.jpg have naturalWidth = 240px) and are upscaled to 800x400 with object-fit:cover, so they appear blurry. Replace with higher-resolution originals.

action_items: Optional cosmetic: align .carousel-container height (500px) with the 400px image height on the accueil carousel to remove the empty strip.
Optional: replace the 240px-wide images in the a-propos carousel with higher-resolution files (currently blurry after upscale to 800px).
critical_code_review_comments: assets/js/carousel.js smoothReturnToStart() animates back to 0 but leaves carouselSlide.style.transition = 'none'; the next click after a full loop jumps instantly without the 0.6s ease (transition is re-set inside updateCarousel, so impact is limited to the first frame - low risk but worth noting).
carousel.css keeps a duplicated rule block for .carousel-slide img (lines 20-25 then 27-33 with max-width:700px overridden by width:100%); safe to collapse into one rule (DRY).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both reported bugs (accueil gallery images not displaying, apropos prev/next buttons overlapping images) are fixed and verified at 1440x900 and 390x800. Only cosmetic items remain: 100px dead space inside the 500px-high accueil carousel container, and low-res source images on the apropos carousel. Test via public preview URL, PHP served on port 3000; wait ~900-1500ms after each arrow click before reading style.transform.
rca_of_the_issue: Bug #1 was caused by the removed 45MB <video> element plus relative image paths resolving against the /accueil/ subfolder; now all 8 imgs use ../images/... and resolve to /images/... and load correctly. Bug #2 was caused by .carousel-prev/.carousel-next being offset at left:60px/right:70px and by object-fit:contain leaving empty side bands; unified carousel.css (left/right:10px, 42px round buttons) and object-fit:cover fix it - measured gaps are exactly 10px on both carousels.
